label: Shelly RGBW2
_comment: RGBW2 runs in one of two mutually exclusive device-side modes: color mode (one unified RGBW output, /color/0/...) or white mode (four independent dimmable channels, /white/0-3/...). This template targets a color-mode device only -- there's no meaningful 'toggle just white' via the simple on/off command endpoint in that mode (the whole-light on/off below controls all four channels together). The 'Set color'/'Set white %' entries below are reference only (this page never publishes anything itself, see mappings-commands.ejs) -- showing the exact topic+value shape a real Loxone RGB/White output sends. To actually make either one work, the mapping itself needs the Shelly RGBW/White transform (mode rgb/rgb-percent/white) selected on its Loxone -> MQTT form, not a plain passthrough -- verified end-to-end against a real device, both the H,S,V-based rgb mode and Loxone's own packed Analog input RGB (rgb-percent) mode.

commands.label: Set color (needs Shelly RGBW/White transform, mode rgb or rgb-percent)
Set white % (needs Shelly RGBW/White transform, mode white)
